venues.name: The Dome by Rutter Mills

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Box Office is open on show days 3 hours prior to show time. Tickets are available for purchase on our website thedomevb.com
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: We accept all major credit cards.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pickup at the box office. Don't forget to bring a photo ID that matches the name on the ticket order! Unfortunately, guests aren't able to leave tickets at Will Call for others to pick up. If you're meeting up with friends, we recommend arranging a time and place to hand off tickets directly. If tickets or passes are being left for you - including Meet & Greet passes, backstage passes, press/media passes, or tickets from the tour or a promotional company - they'll only be available at the box office. These items usually arrive close to door time, so please plan to pick them up then and not earlier.

venues.parkingDetail: There is no onsite parking at the venue but plenty of public parking within blocks.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Yes, accessible seating locations can be found in section 100WC or 302WC for all shows. There is additional accessible seating for reserved floor shows.

generalInfo.generalRule: For general information for the venue visit thedomevb.com
generalInfo.childRule: Our venue is all ages, unless otherwise noted on a show. Children 2 and under do not require a ticket, but must sit on a caregiver's lap if they are located in the seats.

venues.name: Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Open Monday and Friday from 10AM to 4PM. On show days we will be open at 10AM.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Pick up tickets 2 hours prior to show. CUSTOMER MUST PRESENT THE ACTUAL CREDIT CARD USED TO PLACE ORDER AND A PHOTO I.D. located at the Box Office adjacent to main gates. Internet & phone orders (with will call option selected) will be available for pickup beginning at approximately 2 hours prior to show time. Customer will be required to present photo id and actual credit card used to purchase tickets.

venues.parkingDetail: All parking lots are adjacent to Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach. Parking lots open an hour before the scheduled gate time. General admission parking comes with your ticket. If you want easier entry and exit, go for Premier Parking or VIP Parking at point of purchase. Limited spaces available in Premier Parking and VIP Parking.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating available at Box Office at Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach, tm on line, charge by phone and all ticket centers. For additional information please visit: https://www.veteransunitedhomeloansamphitheater.com/accessibility *** Ticket purchases for sight & hearing impaired patrons should be directed to Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater - ticket office at the venue. Call (757) 368-3000 *** The accessible sections at Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater at Virginia Beach can accommodate wheelchairs, gurneys, crutches, walkers and other modes of accessibility.

generalInfo.generalRule: All items are subject to change per artist restrictions. NO bottles, coolers, or pets. NO weapons or recording devices are permitted. Blankets and cushions are allowed (restricted on some shows). Your safety and security are most important to us. generalInfo.childRule: Children 2 and under free on lap.
